title: Platform access handback + FinOps & SOC2 playbook sync
next_steps: Jordan to share SOC2 playbook draft link by 2026-10-22 (link: https://internal.redwood/docs/soc2-playbook)
Priya to run access rotation runbook in staging and send results & logs by 2026-10-26
Marcus to reconcile the +12% October infra billing spike with billing report and share 1-pager by 2026-10-23
action_items: Owner: Lena Morris | Item: Schedule sandbox KMS rotation window | Due: 2026-10-24
Owner: Samir Patel | Item: Attach proof-of-rotation to SOC2 artifact tracker | Due: 2026-10-27

summary: Cross-functional sync to coordinate the platform access handback from the infra contractors, confirm KMS rotation windows, run a quick FinOps spike triage, and align on SOC2 playbook artifacts for the upcoming readiness audit. Agreed owners, dates, and a short staging test for the rotation. Open item: Marcus to investigate an unexplained billing bump tied to a GPU farm reconfiguration.
transcript:
[00:00] Jordan: Hey all, thanks for hopping on. This is the platform access handback sync — 30, uh 45 minutes on the calendar. Quick roll call?
[00:18] Lena: Lena here. Got calendar up, thank you.
[00:22] Marcus: Marcus, Finance.
[00:24] Samir: Samir on Security.
[00:26] Rosa: Rosa, Compliance.
[00:28] Priya: Priya Nair from platform, hi.
[00:30] Evan: Evan McCoy, platform ops.
[00:32] Jordan: Cool. Agenda — handback timeline, KMS / key rotation, FinOps billing spike, SOC2 artifacts mapping, then next steps. If anything else, shout.
[00:48] Lena: Quick context: external contractors are sunsetting access Friday EOD, we need to ensure we have no leftover service accounts and keys.
[00:55] Priya: Yeah, we validated the list last week but there were a couple of POCs that bounced back in the last audit. I have a staging runbook we'll exercise.
[01:08] Samir: Important we capture proof of rotation for SOC2 — screenshots aren't great, need logs exported to the artifact tracker.
[01:16] Rosa: Agreed. The auditor folks asked for key rotation timestamps and the HSM transfer notes.
[01:22] Marcus: Also from finance — we saw a billing spike in early October that lines up with a GPU cluster reconfigure. Need to tie that back before handback. Could be unrelated but want it closed.
[01:33] Jordan: Ok, let's walk through KMS plan first. Priya, do you want to run the staging steps?
[01:38] Priya: Sure, step one: snapshot current key metadata, step two: schedule rotation for sandbox, step three: verify token exchange with services. We'll do a dry-run in staging tonight at 22:00 PST. I will record logs, but note voiced caveat: some services don't gracefully retry, so we have a fallback plan to route traffic to a read-only mode.
[02:04] Lena: When you say snapshot — is that the encrypted export or just metadata? We prefer encrypted exports stored in the vault.
[02:12] Priya: Metadata plus a KMS-wrapped export. We'll drop the export into Vault path, hash it, and attach to the tracker.
[02:18] Samir: Make sure HashiCorp Vault policies are in place so only the evidence pipeline can read them. We don't want ad-hoc downloads.
[02:27] Evan: Quick ops note: we'll also validate RBAC after rotation; secrets-manager callers will be checked against roles. If anything fails we'll open an immediate rollback run.
[02:36] Marcus: And the billing spike — I pulled the usage trends. There's a ~12% uptick week of Oct 3rd, GPU-hours up and a small increase in disk egress. I flagged a PR where infra changed autoscaling parameters mid-deploy.
[02:51] Jordan: Could the contractor activity have triggered the autoscale?
[02:54] Marcus: Possibly. The timestamps overlap. We'll need an event correlation between deploy IDs and billing IDs.
[03:02] Priya: I can pull deploy IDs from the orchestration logs and correlate to scale events — send me the billing report, Marcus.
[03:10] Marcus: Will do. I'll attach the billing CSV to the ticket.
[03:14] Jordan: Good. Back to SOC2 — Rosa, what are the must-have artifacts for rotation?
[03:19] Rosa: We need evidence of key rotation schedule, proof that old keys are revoked, access control changes (RBAC diffs), and an approved change ticket. Preferably a signed PDF of the change review.
[03:30] Samir: For proof, logs must be immutable and timestamped — so S3 with retention plus notification to the tracker. Screenshots are accepted only if accompanied by logs.
[03:40] Priya: Noted. The staging dry-run will generate logs to confirm. I'll pipe 3 different services through during the test to catch edge cases.
[03:50] Lena: On handback, we also need to confirm service accounts used by contractors — there's about eight of them listed. Who owns the cleanup?
[03:58] Evan: Ops will own the cleanup. We'll list service accounts scheduled for deletion and a 72-hour grace period for any business exceptions.
[04:07] Jordan: What's the plan if a deletion causes a client-impacting outage?
[04:10] Evan: Rollback, reapply old key binding, then do a controlled rotation. We'll have runbook steps and a communication template.
[04:19] Marcus: Can you include the estimated cost impact of rollback? We need to add that to the change ticket.
[04:24] Evan: Yep, I'll put a simple line item estimate.
[04:27] Jordan: Ok next — on-call ownership. After handback, who owns day-to-day alerts for platform infra?
[04:33] Lena: IT to own basic access issues, platform ops to own runtime alerts. We'll update the on-call rota accordingly.
[04:40] Rosa: Add compliance on the escalation path for any suspicious access patterns.
[04:44] Samir: And Security will take severity 1 access breaches.
[04:47] Jordan: Great. Any blockers for the dry-run tonight?
[04:51] Priya: Only that I need the staging KMS credentials and the vault path. Lena, can you send those by EOD?
[04:57] Lena: I'll share via the secure channel after this meeting.
[05:00] Jordan: Cool. Next, Marcus — billing spike triage plan?
[05:03] Marcus: I'll create a one-pager: correlated timestamps, affected services, suspected root cause, and recommended mitigation. Expect it by Friday the 23rd.
[05:12] Priya: When you make the one-pager, include deploy IDs so I can slice logs faster.
[05:16] Marcus: Good call.
[05:18] Samir: Small note on evidence: when artifacts go to the tracker, prefix them with project and date so auditors can trace. No ambiguous filenames.
[05:26] Rosa: Also include who approved the change — auditor asks for approver identity and time.
[05:30] Jordan: All right, let's capture concrete action items. I'll read back owners after we list them.
[05:36] [00:05:36] Priya: Action 1 — run KMS rotation dry-run in staging at 22:00 PST tonight; record logs; owner: Priya; due: 2026-10-19 23:30 PST.
[05:49] Lena: Action 2 — send staging KMS credentials & Vault path to Priya; owner: Lena; due: 2026-10-19 EOD.
[05:56] Marcus: Action 3 — compile billing one-pager and attach CSV; owner: Marcus; due: 2026-10-23.
[06:03] Evan: Action 4 — generate RBAC diff CSV and send to compliance; owner: Evan; due: 2026-10-25.
[06:10] Samir: Action 5 — attach rotation proof to SOC2 artifact tracker with immutable logs; owner: Samir; due: 2026-10-27.
[06:18] Jordan: Good. Any risks we didn't call out?
[06:21] Priya: Resource contention if multiple teams trigger hot-redeploys during rotation window — we should tag the window as 'no deploys'.
[06:29] Lena: I'll add a freeze window to the scheduling ticket.
[06:33] Marcus: One risk from finance — unexpected egress during prove-out. Add a budget guard.
[06:38] Jordan: We'll add a spend cap alert. Evan, can you configure a temporary budget alert?
[06:43] Evan: Yes, will do a $500/day guard for the rotation window.
[06:46] Jordan: Cool. Rosa, any further compliance asks?
[06:50] Rosa: Please include the change approver's signature line in the ticket and a short narrative describing rollback criteria.
[06:56] Jordan: Noted. All right, let's do a quick recap of next steps.
[07:01] Jordan: Jordan to share SOC2 playbook draft by Oct 22. Priya to run dry-run tonight and send logs. Lena to provide staging creds and freeze window. Marcus to produce billing one-pager by Oct 23. Evan to validate RBAC and add budget guard. Samir to attach artifacts to tracker.
[07:20] Marcus: Quick question — will the audit team want raw logs or zipped exports?
[07:24] Rosa: Zipped exports with checksums are preferred. Include provenance metadata.
[07:30] Priya: I'll produce zipped archives and sha256sum them.
[07:34] Jordan: Anything else?
[07:36] Lena: No. Good sync.
[07:38] Jordan: Thanks, team. I'll follow up in email with links and timeline. Meeting adjourned.
[45:30] [END]
